cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I may need help moving on Friday. You may reserve the day for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I help Alex paint instead? I already promised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paint before people. Provisionally granted. You may keep your phone on for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Full battery. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. A full battery is approved, though Alex gets your actual hands. You may call this planning.

reason: Turn the competing commitment and offered phone availability into permissions A grants while judging their loyalty value without naming a test.
